convert_tensor_to_image: convert a PyTorch tensor to a numpy image array with optional normalization and clipping
convert_tensor_to_lab_image: convert a PyTorch tensor to an RGB numpy array from LAB color space
convert_tensor_to_color_label_map: convert a one-hot label tensor into a colorful label map image using a colormap
convert_tensor_to_gray_label_map: convert a one-hot label tensor into a grayscale label map numpy array
colorize_gray_image: colorize a grayscale label image tensor using the Colorize class with a configurable colormap
